福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

台灣府城的城門The City Gates of Tainan

先講一件怪事：清朝統治的前四十年，台灣的首府竟然完全沒有城牆。是北京不准蓋。清廷擔心，有城牆的城市一旦被叛軍攻佔，就成了對抗帝國的堡壘。耶穌會傳教士繪於 1699 到 1704 年間的《康熙台灣輿圖》，看得到十字大街，卻完全沒有城池。1722 年朱一貴事件爆發。1723 年，府城建起木柵，設七座竹製城門。1733 年在木柵外環植刺竹；1736 年，城門改為土石構造。1749 年再加種一圈綠珊瑚，一種汁液有毒的灌木。一座用「植物學」防守的城市！1775 年，蔣元樞為方便濱海居民出入，增建小西門，城門達到八座。1788 年林爽文事件平定後，福康安奏請乾隆將城垣改為磚石。全盛時期共有十四座城門；十四座之中，如今只剩四座。大南門是全台僅存的甕城：攻破第一道門，就掉進甕裡。

Here's a strange fact: for its first forty years under the Qing, the capital of Taiwan had no city walls at all. Beijing forbade them. The Qing court feared that rebels could turn a walled city into a fortress against the empire. The Kangxi Map of Taiwan, drawn by Jesuit missionaries between 1699 and 1704, shows cross-shaped main streets and no walls at all. Then came the Zhu Yi-gui uprising of 1722. In 1723, the city built a wooden palisade with seven bamboo gates. In 1733, a hedge of thorny bamboo was planted around the palisade. In 1736, the gates were rebuilt in earth and stone. In 1749 came a second hedge of firestick plants, shrubs with poisonous sap. A city defended by botany! In 1775, the official Jiang Yuan-shu added the Little West Gate for the seaside residents, bringing the count to eight. After the Lin Shuang-wen rebellion ended in 1788, Fukang'an petitioned the Qianlong Emperor to rebuild the walls in brick and stone. At its greatest extent, the city had fourteen gates. Of fourteen gates, only four survive today. The Great South Gate is Taiwan's last barbican: break the first gate, and you are in the jar.

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

府城曾有十四座城門。從清初不准築城，到木柵、刺竹、土石，再到磚石城垣，城門的變化就是台南的城市史；如今只剩四座，大南門還是全台僅存的甕城。

Old Tainan once had fourteen city gates. The story of its walls, from no wall at all to wooden fences, thorny bamboo and finally brick and stone, is the story of the city. Only four gates survive today.

  1. 1723朱一貴事件後建木柵，設七座竹製城門。After the Zhu Yigui uprising, a wooden fence with seven bamboo gates goes up.
  2. 1733–1736木柵外環植刺竹，城門改為土石構造。Thorny bamboo is planted outside, and the gates are rebuilt in earth and stone.
  3. 1775增建小西門，正城八門到齊。The Little West Gate is added, completing the eight main gates.
  4. 1788林爽文事件後，城垣改為磚石。After the Lin Shuangwen uprising, the walls are rebuilt in brick and stone.
  5. 今天 Today十四座城門只剩四座。Four of the fourteen gates remain.

認識景點

About the place

城牆、城垣：圍繞城市的牆。四十年間，台灣首府沒有城牆。 設防、加固：讓一個地方能抵擋攻擊。起初清廷拒絕加固這座城。 木柵：用木樁圍成的柵欄。1723 年府城建木柵，設七座竹門。 刺竹：帶尖刺的竹子。1733 年在木柵外環植一圈刺竹。

city wall: A wall built around a city. For forty years, Taiwan's capital had none. fortify: To make a place strong against attack. At first, the Qing court refused to fortify the city. palisade: A fence of wooden stakes. In 1723, the city built one with seven bamboo gates. thorny bamboo: Bamboo with sharp thorns. In 1733, a hedge of it was planted around the palisade.

綠珊瑚：一種汁液有毒的灌木。1749 年再加種一圈。 奏請、請願：正式向統治者提出請求。福康安奏請皇帝改建城垣。 殘跡：殘留下來的一小部分。小東門附近留有城垣殘跡。 甕城：城門外加的一圈圓牆。大南門是全台僅存的甕城城門。

firestick plant: A shrub with poisonous sap. A second hedge of it was planted in 1749. petition: To formally ask a ruler for something. Fukang'an petitioned the emperor to rebuild the walls. remnant: A small part that is left. Wall remnants survive near the Little East Gate. barbican: An extra round wall in front of a gate. The Great South Gate is Taiwan's only surviving barbican gate.

康熙台灣輿圖：耶穌會傳教士繪於 1699 到 1704 年的地圖：有十字大街，沒有城牆。 正城八門：正城有八座城門，各有正式名稱，例如大南門叫寧南門。 大東門：「東安門」在東面，朝向城外；「迎春門」在西面，朝向城內。 小西門：1970 年拓路時，整座小西門被搬進成大校區。

the Kangxi Map of Taiwan: A map drawn by Jesuit missionaries between 1699 and 1704. It shows cross-shaped streets and no walls. the Main City gates: The Main City had eight gates. Each gate has a formal name, like Ningnan Gate for the Great South Gate. the Great East Gate: Gate of Eastern Peace is on the east side, facing outside the city. Gate of Welcoming Spring is on the west side, facing inside. the Little West Gate: When the road was widened in 1970, the whole gate was moved to the NCKU campus.

碑林：大南門旁，六十餘方清代碑碣集中在一起。

stele forest: More than sixty Qing steles stand together beside the Great South Gate.

實景照片

Photos on site

大東門（東安門） The Great East Gate

大東門是現存的四座城門之一。這一面朝東、朝向城外，拱門上方的石頭刻著正式名稱「東安門」；上面是紅柱白牆的兩層城樓。

The Great East Gate is one of the four gates that still stand. This side faces east, out of the old city. The stone above the arch carries its official name, Dong-an Gate, and a two-story tower sits on top.

大東門（迎春門） The city side of the East Gate

同一座大東門，朝向城內的這一面掛著「迎春門」的匾額，意思是「迎接春天的門」。每年立春的迎春禮就在這裡舉行，中斷百年後在 2017 年恢復。

This is the same gate from the city side. The board here reads Welcome Spring Gate. The spring welcome ceremony is held here each year at the start of spring, revived in 2017 after a century.

城門的示禁碑 The 1848 tablet

大東門的門洞裡嵌著 1848 年的石碑，官府規定守城的兵丁，不准向進出城門的農民、商人和牛車勒索錢財。小西門的門洞裡也有一塊類似的告示。

A stone tablet from 1848 is set inside the East Gate. It ordered the gate guards not to demand money from farmers, traders and ox carts passing through. The Little West Gate has a similar notice.

小西門（靖波門） The Little West Gate

小西門是 1775 年增建的城門，石匾刻著另一個名字「靖波門」。1970 年為了拓寬馬路，整座城門搬到成功大學光復校區重建。

The Little West Gate was added in 1775, and its stone board gives its other name, Calm Waves Gate. In 1970, when the road was widened, the whole gate was moved and rebuilt on a university campus.

府城城牆遺跡 A piece of the old city wall

成大校園裡還留著一段清代府城的城牆，叫做「小東門段城垣殘蹟」。從這段牆可以想像，當年府城被城牆整圈圍起來的樣子。

A stretch of the Qing-era city wall still stands on the university campus. It helps you imagine the old city ringed by walls.

靠近看城牆 A closer look at the wall

靠近看：城牆用三合土（石灰、砂和土混合）一層一層夯實築成，裡面還看得到小石子。

Up close, you can see the wall was built in layers of packed lime, sand and earth, with small stones inside.
